notes.filename_convention: All tabular service data uses flat <table>.csv filenames (e.g. messages.csv, events.csv, works.csv) matching what ships on disk. The records_<table>.csv convention from TASK_FORMAT §7.4 was not applied to this bundle.
notes.input_bundle: Working artifacts ship in the task-root `data/` folder. The folder is part of the input bundle handed to the harness; both the harness and the model have access. The model is not announced about the folder in its system prompt - it discovers artifacts through standard file tools as the scenario unfolds.
notes.google-maps-api: Includes records_geocodes.csv in addition to records_places.csv. Routes/directions are computed by the harness at request time via haversine and are not pre-baked in CSV.
